name: ad_ui_reward_card
layout: horizontal strip, 3 frames of 74x110, no extrude, no trim

nine_slice.stretch: centre + edges; centre is a flat fill per state, so 74x110 is the design size and other sizes stay clean

text.font: arc_fnt_m5x7 (AD-029 atlas; caps, proportional advance = ink width + 1, space 3, line step 9)
text.rune_name: centred in rune_name, 1 line, ui-gold-4 idx 5
text.behaviour_line: word-wrapped, centred in behaviour_line (max 5 lines of 9 px), ui-text-3 idx 8
text.content: ONE new-behaviour sentence per card (AD-017 supplies it), no title prefix

rune_icon: AD-033 ad_ico_* 16x16 drawn at 1x in rune_icon_slot (icon brings its own plate)

state_cues.hover: bright gold frame + 3-px corner studs; code lifts the card 4 px
state_cues.selected: brightest double frame (text-3 outer) + bright inner fill + studs

status: CANDIDATE (FINAL needs Game Art chief APPROVE)
